test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All eggs are oats.

All oats are buckets.

All buckets are plastics.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All buckets are eggs.

(II) Some plastics are oats.

(III) All plastics are buckets.

options.text: All the conclusions I, II and III follow
Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/208a69cb259b08db67f4d1a123c57b89950720f2271d909e8bb9b63eac7fc6b6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All buckets are eggs → Does not follow (As all eggs are oats and all oats are buckets. So, it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some plastics are oats → Follow (As all oats are buckets and all buckets are plastics. As all oats comes in buckets which whole comes in plastics, therefore, some plastics are oats is true.)

III. All plastics are buckets → Does not follow (As all buckets are plastics. So, it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows**"
